forbiddenBody: This area is for head-office administrators and country managers who have signed in with their second factor.
managerNote: As a country manager you see the users of your country: you can end their sessions or block a lost device. Roles, accounts and lists are managed by the head office.
offlineBanner: You are offline. The administration console needs a connection; it will refresh when the connection is back.
offlineBody: Administration works with live data from the server. Connect to the internet and this page loads by itself.
deleted: Deleted. Devices will drop it at their next sync.
discardBody: What you typed in this form has not been saved.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
nameFallbackHint: Optional. When empty, the Arabic name is shown.
codeFixedHint: Codes cannot be changed after creation.
searchUsers: Search by name, e-mail or phone
userMissing: This user is not in your list (removed, or outside your country).
noRolesLong: No role yet: this person can sign in but sees no data.
removeRoleBody: {name} loses the role {role} for {scope} with their next request.
removeOwnHqBody: This is your own head-office role. You will lose access to the administration console at once.
guardLastHqRole: This is the last head-office administrator. Assign the role to someone else before removing it.
guardLastHqUser: This is the last head-office administrator and cannot be deactivated. Assign the role to someone else first.
guardSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
revokeExplain: Ending the sessions signs the person out on every device immediately; they can sign in again with a new code. Use it when a phone is lost or an account may be misused.
revokeAllBody: {name} will be signed out on every device right now. Work that was not synced yet stays on their phones until they sign in again.
refreshNotRevoked: The server could not end the saved sign-ins. To be certain, deactivate the account.
deactivateBody: {name} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until the account is reactivated.
banNotUpdated: The sign-in block could not be updated on the server. Try again.
noDevices: No device has synced with this account yet.
revokeDeviceBody: "{device}" of {name} is blocked until you restore it, and all of {name}'s sessions end now.
mfaNote: This role works only after the person enrols an authenticator app at their next sign-in.
noScopeChoices: Nothing to choose from yet: add a country or branch first.
newUserIntro: Accounts are created by administrators; there is no self sign-up. The person then signs in with a code sent to this e-mail or phone.
emailOrPhoneHint: An e-mail, a phone number, or both.
userCreatedRoleFailed: The account was created, but the role could not be assigned. Assign it from the account page.
countriesIntro: A new country becomes available everywhere without an app update: devices receive it at their next sync. Import its boundaries afterwards with the boundary script.
iso2Hint: For example TZ. Used in project codes and photo paths.
iso3Hint: For example TZA. Used for the official boundaries.
currencyHint: Three-letter ISO code, for example TZS.
inactiveCountryNote: An inactive country stays in existing records but is no longer offered for new entries.
countryHasBranches: This country still has {count} branches. Delete or move them first, or deactivate the country instead.
deleteCountryBody: {name} disappears from every device. If it is still used by projects, deactivate it instead.
branchCodeHint: Capital letters, digits, - or _, for example PEMBA.
countryFixedHint: The country of a branch cannot be changed.
areasHint: Choose the regions, districts or wards this branch serves. Choosing an area includes everything inside it.
areasNone: No administrative areas are known for this country yet. Import its boundaries first; you can add the areas later.
areasMissing: {count} chosen areas no longer exist; remove them.
areasFromServer: Areas read from the server (this device has not received them yet).
deleteBranchBody: {name} disappears from every device. Roles granted for this branch stop working.
optionsIntro: These lists fill the multiple-choice questions of the community profile. Names appear in each user's language; the code never changes.
optionCodeHint: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and _, for example fishing. Never shown to users.
otherKept: The "Other" option opens the free-text box and is always kept.
inactiveOptionNote: An inactive option stays in existing profiles but is no longer offered.
deleteOptionBody: "{name}" is no longer offered. Profiles that chose it keep it.
fxIntro: Value of one unit of each currency in US dollars. Reports use the latest rate on or before today; add a new rate instead of changing an old one.
rateHint: For example 0.00038 for one Tanzanian shilling.
effectiveHint: The rate applies from this date until a newer one.
fxPlaceholderBody: The current rates are indicative placeholders, so every US-dollar figure in reports is approximate. Enter the official rates, then mark them as official.
fxClearBody: The "approximate figures" notice disappears from dashboards and salary reports. Do this only after entering the official rates.
deleteRateBody: The {currency} rate of {date} will no longer be used; the previous rate applies again.
settingsIntro: Settings every device reads after sign-in. Devices pick up a change at their next refresh.
serverConstant: the server still uses the default
setting_duplicates_radius_m: Duplicate check: radius around a new project
setting_map_local_points_min_zoom: Map: zoom level for single points
packsHowBody: Packs are built and uploaded by a script run by a technical administrator on a computer with the basemap file. The pack then appears here and in every device's settings.
packsHowNote: The script uses the service key, which never belongs in the browser. Add --dry-run to see the estimated size first.
noPacksBody: Build the first pack with the command above.
err_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
err_mfa_required: Confirm your sign-in with your authenticator app first.
err_not_authenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
err_session_revoked: Your session was ended. Sign in again.
err_user_not_found: This user no longer exists or is outside your country.
err_device_not_found: This device is not known for this user.
err_last_hq_admin: The last head-office administrator cannot lose the role or be deactivated.
err_cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
err_invalid_role_scope: This role cannot have this scope.
err_invalid_scope: The chosen country or branch does not exist.
err_invalid_device_id: The device identifier is not valid.
err_rate_limited: Too many changes in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
err_user_exists: An account with this e-mail or phone already exists.
err_stale: Someone else changed this entry in the meantime. The list has been reloaded; check it and try again.
err_duplicate: This code is already in use (also by deleted entries).
err_check_failed: A value is not in the expected format.
err_reference: This entry refers to something that does not exist.
err_offline: You are offline. Connect and try again.
err_network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
err_server: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
v_iso2: Two Latin capital letters, for example TZ
v_iso3: Three Latin capital letters, for example TZA
v_currency: Three Latin capital letters, for example TZS
v_taken_deleted: Used by a deleted entry ({name}); restore it instead
v_option_code: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and _, starting with a letter
v_name_duplicate: An option with this name already exists in the list
v_rate: A number greater than zero, at most 10 decimals
v_rate_taken: This currency already has a rate on this date; correct that one instead
v_rate_taken_deleted: A deleted rate exists for this currency and date
v_grant_exists: This person already has this role with this scope
v_email_or_phone: Give an e-mail or a phone number
v_email_taken: An account with this e-mail already exists
v_phone_taken: An account with this phone already exists
